UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Cross-device cloud save state for a user's SC-500 quiz progress, study round, cumulative per-question attempt stats, bookmarks, and language preference.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this progress document.

studyRound.description: Current study lap/round number (1周目, 2周目, etc.).

userRecords.description: Map of questionId to current-round UserAnswerRecord.

questionStats.description: Map of questionId to cumulative QuestionAttemptStats (attempts, corrects, lastAttemptedAt).

bookmarkedIds.description: Bounded list of bookmarked question IDs.

roundHistory.description: Bounded list of completed RoundSummary objects.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was last updated.

/userProgress/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated user's synced SC-500 learning progress keyed by their Firebase Auth UID.
